 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order
Applicant has filed this first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 on behalf of the applicant for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.228/2022 registered at P.S. Palasia, District Indore (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 420, 409 and 201 of IPC and Section 6/1 of M.P. Nikshepako Ke Hito Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam.
He is in jail since 17.05.2022.
